caption: The image is a drawing of a single metal coffee pot set against a plain, light-colored background. The coffee pot has a tall, conical shape with a wide base that narrows towards the top. The pot is predominantly red and decorated with ornate painted designs in multiple colors. The body and lid of the pot are adorned with swirling floral patterns, featuring large flowers in shades of white, cream, yellow, and black, along with curved green, yellow, and red leaves. The spout is long, slender, and curves upwards at the end, and is painted red with subtle decorative marks. The handle is also red, arching out and up from the side, with similar decoration as the body. The lid is domed with a small knob on top, featuring yellow and red decorative stripes. The base is slightly flared and encircled with a yellow and red scroll-like pattern. The drawing is signed in the lower left corner with the name "C. Heinetz."
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
